subject: Request: Security-backed pilot subsidy for Private VPC evaluation
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@statera-health.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Wu <jwu@statera-health.com>, procurement@statera-health.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC pilot: request for security-backed subsidy and evidence

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Private VPC flow looks promising for our PHI-handling workflows. Before we can spin up a dedicated pilot with inference inside our VPC, procurement needs confirmation of two things to justify a pilot credit/subsidy to leadership:

- Short checklist of security evidence we can provide to our security/compliance board (SOC2 report, high-level network architecture, KMS/keys approach, audit log retention).
- Confirmation that the pilot can be isolated (dedicated capacity, no co-tenancy) and supports customer-managed keys (or a clear crosswalk to Redwood KMS).

We are targeting a 6-week evaluation, but the execs want a promotional credit (or trial-top-up) to cover the initial compute spend — ballpark $20k — to run model tuning + 4 weeks of inference. If Redwood can provide a conditional subsidy contingent on signed DPA and a short security attestation, we can proceed this month.

Can you share the list of docs you can provide, and whether you can extend trial credits tied to the Private/VPC pilot? Also please include any timeline constraints or gating items on your side.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Platform Security
Statera Health

Attachment: Statera_POI_requirements.pdf (procurement summary)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@statera-health.com>
Cc: Jason Wu <jwu@statera-health.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pilot: request for security-backed subsidy and evidence

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask and for outlining the board concerns. Happy to run this down. Short answers up front: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II, a redacted architecture diagram showing dedicated capacity and network controls, and support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS) for the pilot. We also emit audit logs (token-level latency/cost tracing) and can configure retention windows per contract.

On credits: we typically approve security-tied pilot subsidies for Private/VPC evaluations when there is an explicit procurement timeline and an executed DPA/PO. For a first pass, I can propose a conditional promotional credit of $15,000 (applied as platform credit to the account) that becomes payable/active once the DPA is signed and the connectivity pre-check completes. If Statera needs the full $20k up-front, I will need an additional approval from our finance lead (cc'd: markus.klein).

I’m looping in Monica (Sales Ops) and Karthik (Security) to confirm these artifacts are sufficient and to coordinate internal approval for the credit.

What I will attach here: Redwood redacted SOC2 Type II, link to our DPA draft (DocuSign), and a short checklist for the network pre-check. Can you send over the Statera network diagram (high level; do not include internal IPs) and confirm which KMS provider you intend to use?

Proposed next steps:
- Statera sends network diagram + selected KMS provider (this week)
- We circulate the DPA and complete redlines (target 3 business days)
- Internal approval for $15k conditional credit -> we apply promo code after DPA signature and connectivity pre-check

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Redwood_Redacted.pdf; DPA_Statera_Redwood_Draft.docx; statera-network-diagram-req.pdf

Subject: Re: Private VPC pilot: request for security-backed subsidy and evidence

Aditya — thanks for the proposal. Approving a conditional $15k promotional credit is fine from Sales Ops provided we get:

1) Executed DPA (DocuSign envelope must show signature completion).
2) Redacted SOC2 (attached by you — ok).
3) Network pre-check completed and sign-off from Karthik's team.
4) Procurement PO or signed purchase intent for the pilot (procurement@statera-health.com).

Note to Markus: can billing/finance create a promo code tied to deal ST-2091 that automatically applies once the DPA completes? If finance needs anything else for audit, flag now.

I also want legal to confirm the DPA redlines — Karen, can you prioritize? We should aim for DPA execution within 72 hours of receipt.

Monica
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@statera-health.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pilot: request for security-backed subsidy and evidence

Quick technical confirm from security/compliance side:

- Customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported via our KMS integration; we support AWS KMS and external HSMs via key-wrapping. Key rotation policies can be mirrored to meet customer SLAs.
- Dedicated capacity: for Private/VPC pilots we allocate a dedicated GPU pool and single-tenant inference runners; no co-tenancy with hosted customers.
- Audit logs: we can provide per-request event streams with 90-day retention by default; longer retention can be added to the contract.
- Network gating: we require a network pre-check (simple connectivity test + allowlist of outgoing egress IP ranges) and a high-level data-flow diagram before enabling the VPC environment.

Action items for Statera: please provide the high-level network/data-flow diagram and specify the KMS vendor (AWS KMS, Vault, Azure Key Vault). Once we have those and the executed DPA, we can sign off and advise Sales Ops to activate the promo credit.

-Karthik
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
